F2: the frontdoor admission of the promotion chain is verified as EVIDENCE instead of being a caller-supplied path - the receipt must live in the canonical screening surface sandbox/runs/<run>/skill-frontdoor-admission.json behind the containment proof, its admission identity must re-derive from the screened content identity, the run directory and its own decision time exactly the way the checker derives it, BOTH analyzer reports are opened from the same screening run and the declared statuses, severities and counts must re-derive under the very classifiers the checker uses, the receipt records candidate.content_digest (frontdoor contract advanced to 1.1.0, the sha256 of the screened SKILL.md bytes) as the form the promotion compares while the whole-tree source_revision digest stays provenance and is never compared against content, the approval payload covers frontdoor_admission_digest so the owner decision is signed over exactly the screened admission the promotion consumes (OWNER_APPROVAL_ADMISSION_UNBOUND / OWNER_APPROVAL_ADMISSION_MISMATCH - a fabricated or substituted admission fails the owner signature, and the signature-payload coverage property is itself bound by a test), the post-adoption readback cross-checks the recorded pair, and the checker re-anchors the staged candidate after the analyzers ran so a receipt cannot describe content the analyzers never measured.
